anchors.statement: The atm-bd plan-hardening SKILL.md must define three run modes: planner with subagents, planner with teammates, and phase lead adversarial to the planner.

pass: skills/plan-hardening/SKILL.md has a Run Modes section defining three modes: planner with subagents, planner with teammates, and lead adversarial, where the phase lead orchestrates against the planner (test_skill_names_three_modes).
fail: skills/plan-hardening/SKILL.md describes one run mode: the team lead routes every pass to reviewers.

anchors.statement: In the atm-bd plan-hardening formulas, the ceremony-qa review step must depend on the step for the final critical-plan-reviewer pass, so ceremony-qa reviews the plan after that pass.

anchors.scope: adds or changes the plan-hardening formulas, step order or SKILL.md flow

pass: skills/plan-hardening/SKILL.md and the fix step description tell the planner: a FAIL from the final critical-plan-reviewer pass is normal because that review is adversarial; fix the findings and continue to ceremony-qa.
fail: The final critical-plan-reviewer FAIL makes the planner start another iteration until it passes.

anchors.statement: The atm-bd plan-hardening SKILL.md must set the default number of review iterations to 2.
anchors.quote: typical/default # of iterations is 2
anchors.summary: Default two iterations
anchors.scope: adds or changes the plan-hardening iteration count, formulas or SKILL.md loop
anchors.deterministic_check: grep -n 'iterations' plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/skills/plan-hardening/SKILL.md shows default 2

fail: The skill runs reviewer cycles until convergence with a cap of 3.

anchors.statement: In the atm-bd plan-hardening iteration formula, the plan-scope-reviewer step and the critical-plan-reviewer step must not depend on each other, so the two passes run in parallel.
anchors.quote: 2 iterations of @plan-scope-reviewer and @critical-plan-reviewer and adversaries (if phase-lead orchestrated) run in parallel

anchors.scope: adds or changes the plan-hardening iteration formula step dependencies or adversary dispatch

fail: The critical step needs the scope step, so the critical-plan-reviewer starts only after plan-scope-reviewer closes.

anchors.statement: The atm-bd `adversarial-plan-hardening` reference must forbid giving an adversary the same task in iteration 2 as in iteration 1.
anchors.quote: adversaries should not be given the same task both iterations. new tasks based either on weaknesses uncovered or mixing things up for complete plan coverage

anchors.statement: The atm-bd `adversarial-plan-hardening` reference must instruct the phase lead to review the plan itself and file its own findings, in addition to dispatching reviewers.
